title: Shaun White Snowboarding Xbox 360, Ubisoft - CIB, Tested
descriptionText:
Experience the thrill of snowboarding with Shaun White Snowboarding for Xbox 360. This complete and tested game includes a manual and is rated T for Teen. The game features NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region code, Microsoft Xbox 360 platform, and was released in 2008 by Ubisoft. 

This sports game is perfect for those who love the genre and want to add to their collection. The game is categorized under Video Games and Video Games & Consoles. Get ready to hit the slopes and experience the excitement of snowboarding with Shaun White Snowboarding.
